core_obligations: Flatten X by an admissible blow-up of B.
Conclude finiteness over the dense-open lemma and upgrade to finite locally free.
difficulty_reason: For B quasi-compact quasi-separated, U a quasi-compact open, f : X -> B proper with f^{-1}(U) -> U finite locally free, the lemma produces a U-admissible blow-up B' -> B such that the strict transform X' of X is finite locally free over B'. The retained proof is written: the chapter's flat-after-blowing-up theorem (cited by name) replaces f by a flat finitely presented strict transform; another U-admissible blow-up makes U scheme-theoretically dense in B (standard reduction cited inside the flat-after sequence); the chapter's proper-flat-finite-over-dense-open lemma (collected last wave as L16101) then promotes f to finite; finally finite plus flat of finite presentation is finite locally free (Morphisms of Spaces, lemma finite-flat). Retained author proof at lines 8926-8934.

dedup.scope: Blow-up promotion of proper-over-dense-locally-free situations to finite locally free maps of spaces.
